* dbChange(add new column before refresh) == will be refreshed from SOURCE
* language pack (add extra lang before refresh) ==  **not carried over**
* \*toggleAutoSchedule (true/false) == not carried over **: individual pod's settings honored**
* \*featureFlag(add/Remove) == **not carried over : individual pod's settings honored**
* deleteSpService == **not carried over;**
* \*addFreeForm tag == **not carried over: individual pod's settings honored**
* scaleout/resize == not carried over
* runtimediagnostics (from source to target) = **old RuntimeDiagnostics db is deleted and re-Enabled on the TARGET POD**
* patches = same BusinessApp release and Patch bundles
* source deploymenttemplate and target is starter (at same relLabel) = **post Refresh - TARGET will have DeploymentTemplate**

### Enable feature Flag as post POD Action

Feature flags can now be added individually as a post pod action.

* Value and minVersion are optional fields
* Not all feature flags can be added to an existing BusinessApp POD, please confirm with EnvironmentService team if the flag is supported
* This operation will take 5-10 minutes and can be confirmed in the DevOps portal

retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Onboarding for CloudNative
retrieved_sources.text:
2) Select your Release Set (e.g.: 11.13.24.01.0 00000 Starter GA (X86,ARM64) )

3) You can leave the defaulted ApplicationBOM as your base ApplicationBOM selection.

* In the Override section, provide your service version for Preflight
* Version field is editable. You can copy/paste. Versions are validated by PipelineHub with CloudNative Platform.

* For Preflight Pod submission - Please use "**businessapp-preflight**" cloudnative fleet, it is limited to 2 per service team (based on honest system)
* For Family Pod submission - Please use **your-own** cloudnative fleet, it will be limited based on how much quota your fleet is setup.
* **Currently PipelineHub do not check whether the fleet has enough quota, PLEASE check manually before submission.**
* 
* **You can override any numbers of services at this time. Promotion to TIP ApplicationBOM  is not yet available.**

4) Press blue button "**Provision EnvironmentService POD**" in the bottom of the page 

Update (upgrade) of existing CloudNative POD
----------------------------------------

Existing CloudNative v3 POD can be upgraded to higher version of Monolith as well as CloudNative services.

For Services selection information refer to "Step 7: Ready to Preflight" section of this guide.
